evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked. Rep moved directly into logistics probing after confirming the November 21st booking.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Not applicable — no concerns were raised by the customer during step 2, as step 2 was skipped entirely.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Not addressed. Rep did not offer alternative dates or discuss pricing by day type.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Never asked. Rep never offered a rate lock, never asked for the business, and never asked for confirmation to proceed. Customer was already booked from an auto-booking on November 21st.

top_strength: Brianne efficiently gathered logistics details (addresses, floor heights, elevator access, special items, bed size, TV, box count) and confirmed arrival window without resistance, keeping the call moving and organized.
coaching_note: This call is a follow-up on a pre-booked auto-booking and skips the entire discovery, promises, and close sequence — you must treat every incoming call as a fresh sales opportunity and run the full 15-minute card: start with Two Concerns, deliver the On-Time Guarantee and No Worries coverage, frame pricing, give a personalized estimate, and always ask for the business and confirmation explicitly, even when a booking appears to already exist.
